label: Bible Study
prompt: But now they desire a better country, that is, an heavenly: wherefore God is not ashamed to be called their God: for he hath prepared for them a _____.
verse: But now they desire a better country, that is, an heavenly: wherefore God is not ashamed to be called their God: for he hath prepared for them a city.
note: The faithful pilgrims longed for a better country — and God has a city ready for them.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: But I have _____ for thee, that thy faith fail not: and when thou art converted, strengthen thy brethren.
verse: But I have prayed for thee, that thy faith fail not: and when thou art converted, strengthen thy brethren.
note: Before Peter's denial, Jesus tells him: I've already prayed for thee — and when you turn back, strengthen the others.

label: Sunday School
prompt: And the house, when it was in building, was built of stone made ready before it was brought thither: so that there was neither _____ nor axe nor any tool of iron heard in the house, while it was in building.
verse: And the house, when it was in building, was built of stone made ready before it was brought thither: so that there was neither hammer nor axe nor any tool of iron heard in the house, while it was in building.
note: The temple stones were cut off-site, so building it made no sound of hammer, axe, or iron tool.

label: Deep Water
prompt: Behold, I am the LORD, the God of all _____: is there any thing too hard for me?
verse: Behold, I am the LORD, the God of all flesh: is there any thing too hard for me?
note: God's answer to Jeremiah, who had just bought a field in a city about to fall: nothing is too hard for me.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: Let us hear the _____ of the whole matter: Fear God, and keep his commandments: for this is the whole duty of man.
verse: Let us hear the conclusion of the whole matter: Fear God, and keep his commandments: for this is the whole duty of man.
note: After twelve chapters of 'vanity,' the Preacher's bottom line: fear God, keep his commandments — the whole duty of man.
